rules: :root { --background: #fff; --foreground: #10100f; --muted: #10100fad; --line: #10100f24; --accent: #8f6200; --ui-gutter-x: clamp(14px, 2.6vw, 44px); --ui-gutter-y: clamp(18px, 2.8vw, 40px); --ui-edge-x: var(--ui-gutter-x); }
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { background: var(--background); width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
body { background: var(--background); width: 100%; height: 100%; color: var(--foreground); margin: 0px; font-family: helvetica-neue-lt-pro, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
button, input, textarea, select { font: inherit; }
.webgl-background { z-index: 0; overscroll-behavior: none; touch-action: none; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); position: fixed; inset: 0px; }
.webgl-background canvas { touch-action: none; display: block; }

.preloader { z-index: 20; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92); transform-origin: center bottom; background: 0px 0px; place-items: center; padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 45px); display: grid; position: fixed; inset: 0px; }
.preloader__wave { z-index: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; position: absolute; inset: 0px; }
.preloader__inner { z-index: 1; place-items: center; min-height: 1.4em; display: grid; position: relative; }

.preloader__text { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; font-size: clamp(12px, 1.35vw, 15px); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; display: inline-block; }
.persistent-experience { z-index: 0; position: relative; }
.persistent-experience[data-transitioning="true"] .site-nav { pointer-events: none; }
.experience-page { z-index: 3; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; position: fixed; inset: 0px; }

.is-page-ready .experience-page, .is-entered .experience-page, .is-page-surface-ready .experience-page--projects, .is-page-surface-ready .experience-page--about, .is-page-surface-ready .experience-page--contact { opacity: 1; }
.experience-page--projects { overscroll-behavior: contain; background: rgb(247, 245, 239); overflow: hidden; }
.experience-page--about, .experience-page--contact { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); pointer-events: auto; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); }
.experience-page--home { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); background: 0px 0px; }

[data-text-reveal], [data-text-reveal-heading], [data-text-reveal-kicker], .page-shell__intro > p, .page-shell__intro > h1, .about-language-toggle > button, .about-page__body, .contact-page__links, .projects-gridzoom__intro > p, .projects-gridzoom__intro > h1, .split-heading__line { will-change: opacity, transform; }
.split-heading__line { display: block; }
.site-nav { top: var(--ui-gutter-y); right: var(--ui-edge-x); z-index: 80; pointer-events: auto; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; display: flex; position: fixed; }

.site-nav a, .site-nav button { appearance: none; color: rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.46); cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: 0.045em; text-align: right; text-transform: uppercase; background: 0px 0px; border: 0px; min-width: 74px; padding: 2px 0px 3px; font-size: max(12px, min(0.8vw, 7.8px + 0.28vw)); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.18s, border-color 0.18s, opacity 0.18s, transform 0.18s; }
.site-nav a:hover, .site-nav button:hover { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); transform: translate(-2px); }
.site-nav a[aria-current="page"], .site-nav button[aria-current="page"] { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); }

.brand-home-link { color: inherit; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: auto; font-size: max(13px, min(1vw, 9.75px + 0.35vw)); font-weight: 500; line-height: 0.95; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.18s; display: inline-block; }
.brand-home-link:hover { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); }

.back-circle-control { appearance: none; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); cursor: pointer; pointer-events: auto; transform-origin: 50% center; background: rgb(11, 11, 10); border: 0px; border-radius: 999px; place-items: center; width: clamp(38px, 3.1vw, 46px); height: clamp(38px, 3.1vw, 46px); padding: 0px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.18s, transform 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); display: inline-grid; position: relative; }
.back-circle-control svg { fill: none; stroke: currentcolor; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-width: 2.4px; width: 58%; height: 58%; display: block; }
.back-circle-control:hover { background: rgb(0, 0, 0); transform: scale(0.94); }
.back-circle-control:focus-visible { outline-offset: 4px; outline: rgb(11, 11, 10) solid 2px; }

.mouse-stalker { z-index: 160; color: rgb(11, 11, 10); pointer-events: none; transform-origin: 50% center; will-change: transform, width, height, opacity; width: 18px; height: 18px; position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; }
.mouse-stalker__svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.mouse-stalker__shape { fill: rgb(11, 11, 10); stroke: rgb(11, 11, 10); stroke-width: 1px; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }
.mouse-stalker__label { fill: rgb(255, 255, 255); letter-spacing: 0.035em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: max(10px, min(0.667vw, 6.5px + 0.23345vw)); font-weight: 700; }
.mouse-stalker__arrow { fill: none; stroke: rgb(255, 255, 255); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.4px; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }
.sticker-cursor-preview { z-index: 155; pointer-events: none; transform-origin: 50% 80%; will-change: transform, opacity; width: 102px; height: 102px; position: fixed; top: 0px; left: 0px; }
.sticker-cursor-preview__image { object-fit: contain; opacity: 0.5; filter: drop-shadow(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) 0px 5px 8px); user-select: none; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.page-shell { height: 100svh; padding: var(--ui-gutter-y) var(--ui-edge-x); grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0px, 1fr); display: grid; overflow: hidden; }

.page-shell__header { color: rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.58); letter-spacing: 0.035em; text-transform: uppercase; grid-template-columns: auto auto minmax(0px, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding-right: clamp(120px, 18vw, 260px); font-size: max(13px, min(1vw, 9.75px + 0.35vw)); font-weight: 500; line-height: 0.95; display: grid; }
.page-shell__header span:last-child { justify-self: end; }
.page-shell__intro { align-self: start; width: min(max(460px, 299px + 10.7333vw), 100%); margin-top: clamp(46px, 8vh, 82px); }
.page-shell__intro p { color: rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.48); letter-spacing: 0.045em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px 0px 12px; font-size: max(12px, min(0.8vw, 7.8px + 0.28vw)); line-height: 1; }
.page-shell__intro h1 { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); letter-spacing: 0px; margin: 0px; font-size: max(22px, min(2.4vw, 23.4px + 0.84vw)); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.08; }
.hero-section { align-items: start; }
.home-profile { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); align-self: start; width: min(max(360px, 24vw), 100vw - clamp(28px, 5.2vw, 88px)); }

.home-profile p { color: rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.54); letter-spacing: 0.045em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px 0px 10px; font-size: max(12px, min(0.8vw, 7.8px + 0.28vw)); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; }
.home-profile h1 { letter-spacing: 0px; margin: 0px; font-size: max(24px, 2.8vw); font-weight: 500; line-height: 0.98; }
.home-profile dl { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0px, 1fr)); gap: clamp(12px, 1.6vw, 20px); margin: clamp(18px, 3vh, 28px) 0px 0px; display: grid; }
.home-profile div { border-top: 1px solid rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.16); padding-top: 10px; }
.home-profile dt, .home-profile dd { letter-spacing: 0.018em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px; font-size: max(12px, min(0.8vw, 7.8px + 0.28vw)); line-height: 1.25; }
.home-profile dt { color: rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.42); }
.home-profile dd { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); margin-top: 7px; }

.home-meta { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0px, 1fr)); align-self: end; gap: clamp(12px, 2vw, 28px); width: min(720px, 100vw - clamp(28px, 5.2vw, 88px)); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; display: grid; }
.home-meta div { border-top: 1px solid rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.16); padding-top: 10px; }
.home-meta dt, .home-meta dd { letter-spacing: 0.018em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px; font-size: max(12px, min(0.8vw, 7.8px + 0.28vw)); line-height: 1.25; }
.home-meta dt { color: rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.42); }
.home-meta dd { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); margin-top: 7px; }
.split-text { perspective: 900px; }
.split-text p, .split-text h1 { overflow: hidden; }
.split-text__word { white-space: nowrap; display: inline-block; }
.split-text__char, .split-text__eyebrow-char { will-change: transform, opacity; display: inline-block; }
.split-text__space { display: inline; }
.content-section { min-height: 100svh; padding: clamp(24px,6vw,88px) var(--ui-edge-x); align-items: end; display: grid; }
.content-block { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); width: min(max(620px, 403px + 18.445vw), 100%); padding-block: clamp(18px, 4vw, 48px); }
.content-block p { color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: 0.045em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px 0px 14px; font-size: max(13px, min(0.867vw, 8.45px + 0.30345vw)); }
.content-block h2 { max-width: min(max(620px, 403px + 18.0833vw), 100%); margin: 0px 0px 20px; font-size: max(32px, min(6vw, 46.8px + 2.1vw)); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; }
.content-block span { color: var(--muted); font-size: max(16px, min(1.7vw, 13px + 0.595vw)); line-height: 1.7; display: block; }
.projects-page { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); pointer-events: auto; overscroll-behavior: none; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); height: 100svh; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.persistent-experience:has(.projects-page[data-preview-open="true"]) .experience-page--projects { z-index: 90; }
.home-transition-page { background: var(--background); min-height: 100svh; color: var(--foreground); }
.home-transition-page:has(.about-page) { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); background: rgb(255, 255, 255); }
.home-transition-page:has(.contact-page) { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); background: rgb(255, 255, 255); }
.home-transition-page--home { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); background: 0px 0px; }
.about-page, .contact-page { color: inherit; }
.about-language-toggle { pointer-events: auto; justify-self: start; gap: 8px; display: inline-flex; }

.about-language-toggle button { appearance: none; color: rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.42); cursor: pointer; font: inherit; letter-spacing: 0.045em; text-transform: uppercase; background: 0px 0px; border: 0px; padding: 0px; transition: color 0.18s, transform 0.18s; }
.about-language-toggle button:hover { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.about-language-toggle button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); }
.about-page__content { place-self: center; width: min(max(760px, 494px + 18.2vw), 100%); margin-top: clamp(-48px, -4vh, -18px); }
.about-page__content[lang="ja"] .page-shell__intro h1 { font-size: max(30px, min(4vw, 36.4px + 1.4vw)); }
.about-page__content .page-shell__intro { text-align: center; width: min(max(680px, 442px + 16.2842vw), 100%); margin: 0px auto; }
.about-page__content .page-shell__intro p { margin-bottom: clamp(14px, 2vw, 22px); }
.about-page__content .page-shell__intro h1 { font-size: max(34px, min(5vw, 46.8px + 1.75vw)); line-height: 0.96; }
.about-page__body { border-top: 1px solid rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.14); width: min(max(620px, 403px + 16.275vw), 100%); margin: clamp(28px, 5vh, 48px) auto 0px; padding-top: clamp(16px, 2.4vw, 26px); }
.about-page__body p { color: rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.62); text-align: center; margin: 0px; font-size: max(14px, min(1.2vw, 10.4px + 0.42vw)); line-height: 1.65; }
.about-page__meta { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0px, 1fr)); gap: clamp(14px, 2vw, 26px); margin: clamp(28px, 5vh, 48px) 0px 0px; display: grid; }
.about-page__meta div { border-top: 1px solid rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.14); padding-top: 10px; }
.about-page__meta dt, .about-page__meta dd { letter-spacing: 0.018em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px; font-size: max(12px, min(0.8vw, 7.8px + 0.28vw)); line-height: 1.3; }
.about-page__meta dt { color: rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.42); }
.about-page__meta dd { color: rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.76); margin-top: 8px; }

.about-page__meta a { color: inherit; letter-spacing: 0px; pointer-events: auto; align-items: center; gap: 0.46em; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.18s, opacity 0.18s; display: inline-flex; }
.about-page__meta .inline-link-arrow { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); fill: currentcolor; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 15px; height: 15px; transition: opacity 0.18s; transform: translateY(0.04em); }
.about-page__meta a:hover { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); opacity: 1; }
.about-page__contact-links { justify-items: start; gap: 7px; display: grid; }
.contact-page__content { place-self: center; width: min(max(700px, 455px + 16.7632vw), 100%); margin-top: clamp(-48px, -4vh, -18px); }
.contact-page__content .page-shell__intro { text-align: center; width: min(max(680px, 442px + 16.2842vw), 100%); margin: 0px auto; }
.contact-page__content .page-shell__intro p { margin-bottom: clamp(14px, 2vw, 22px); }
.contact-page__content .page-shell__intro h1 { font-size: max(34px, min(5.2vw, 49.4px + 1.82vw)); line-height: 0.96; }
.contact-page__body { width: min(max(560px, 364px + 14.7vw), 100%); margin: clamp(28px, 5vh, 48px) auto 0px; }

.contact-page__links { border-top: 1px solid rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.16); grid-template-columns: 1fr; justify-items: center; gap: clamp(2px, 0.45vw, 6px); padding-top: clamp(12px, 1.6vw, 18px); display: grid; }

.contact-page__links a { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); letter-spacing: 0px; pointer-events: auto; overflow-wrap: anywhere; text-align: center; justify-content: center; align-items: center; width: fit-content; max-width: calc(100% - clamp(28px, 3vw, 38px)); min-height: clamp(32px, 3.6vw, 40px); font-size: max(18px, min(1.8vw, 15.6px + 0.63vw)); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.18s; display: inline-flex; position: relative; }

.contact-page__links .inline-link-arrow { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); fill: currentcolor; width: clamp(20px, 1.95vw, 26px); height: clamp(20px, 1.95vw, 26px); transition: opacity 0.18s; position: absolute; top: 50%; left: calc(100% + clamp(8px, 0.9vw, 12px)); transform: translateY(-50%); }

.projects-gridzoom { --projects-grid-padding-x: var(--ui-edge-x); height: 100svh; padding: var(--ui-gutter-y) var(--projects-grid-padding-x) var(--ui-gutter-y); grid-template-rows: auto auto minmax(0px, 1fr) auto; gap: clamp(14px, 2.2vw, 30px); display: grid; overflow: hidden; }

.projects-gridzoom__header { color: rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.58); letter-spacing: 0.035em; text-transform: uppercase; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0px, 1fr); align-items: start; gap: 24px; padding-right: clamp(120px, 18vw, 260px); font-size: max(13px, min(1vw, 9.75px + 0.35vw)); font-weight: 500; line-height: 0.95; display: grid; }
.projects-gridzoom__header span:last-child { justify-self: end; }
.projects-language-toggle { pointer-events: auto; gap: 8px; display: inline-flex; }

.projects-language-toggle button { appearance: none; color: rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.42); cursor: pointer; font: inherit; letter-spacing: 0.045em; text-transform: uppercase; background: 0px 0px; border: 0px; padding: 0px; transition: color 0.18s, transform 0.18s; }
.projects-language-toggle button:hover { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.projects-language-toggle button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); }
.projects-gridzoom__intro { z-index: 1; width: min(max(460px, 299px + 10.7333vw), 100%); margin: clamp(46px, 8vh, 82px) 0px 0px; position: relative; }

.projects-gridzoom__intro p { color: rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.48); letter-spacing: 0.045em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px 0px 12px; font-size: max(12px, min(0.8vw, 7.8px + 0.28vw)); line-height: 1; }
.projects-gridzoom__intro h1 { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); letter-spacing: 0px; margin: 0px; font-size: max(21.5px, min(2.3vw, 22.1px + 0.805vw)); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.08; }
.projects-gridzoom__intro h1 span { display: block; }
.projects-gl-gallery { z-index: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100%; min-height: 0px; margin: 0 0 0 calc(var(--projects-grid-padding-x)*-1); touch-action: none; position: relative; overflow: visible; }
.projects-marquee { contain: layout; position: absolute; inset: 0px calc(-1 * clamp(18px, 4vw, 72px)); overflow: visible; }
.projects-marquee__track { will-change: transform; align-items: center; width: max-content; display: flex; position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0px; }
.projects-marquee__set { --gallery-gap: clamp(14px, 2.1vw, 32px); align-items: center; gap: var(--gallery-gap); padding-right: var(--gallery-gap); display: flex; }

.projects-marquee__item { appearance: none; width: max(220px, min(21vw, 239.2px + 7.35vw)); height: max(154px, min(14.9vw, 167.7px + 5.215vw)); color: inherit; cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.72; background: 0px 0px; border: 0px; flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 0px; transition: opacity 0.26s, transform 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); transform: translate(0px, 0px); }

.projects-marquee__item:nth-child(8n+2), .projects-marquee__item:nth-child(8n+4), .projects-marquee__item:nth-child(8n+6), .projects-marquee__item:nth-child(8n+8) { width: max(154px, min(13.8vw, 158.6px + 4.83vw)); height: max(196px, min(18.2vw, 205.4px + 6.37vw)); }
.projects-marquee__item:nth-child(8n+5) { width: max(254px, min(24vw, 271.7px + 8.4vw)); height: max(150px, min(14vw, 159.9px + 4.9vw)); }
.projects-marquee__item:hover { opacity: 1; }
.projects-marquee__figure { background: rgb(233, 230, 223); width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0px; overflow: hidden; }
.projects-marquee__figure img { object-fit: cover; width: 100%; height: 100%; transition: transform 0.52s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); display: block; transform: scale(1.015); }
.projects-marquee__card { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.projects-marquee[data-enter-pending="true"] .projects-marquee__card { opacity: 0; transform-origin: 50% 100%; transform: translateY(84px) scale(0.985); }
.projects-marquee__item:hover .projects-marquee__figure img { transform: scale(1.06); }
.projects-gl-caption { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; min-height: 44px; margin-top: 0px; transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.36s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); transform: translateY(8px); }

.projects-gl-caption span { color: rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.52); letter-spacing: 0.045em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 7px; font-size: max(11px, min(0.733vw, 7.15px + 0.25655vw)); line-height: 1; display: block; }
.projects-gl-caption strong { color: rgb(11, 11, 10); letter-spacing: 0px; font-size: max(14px, min(0.933vw, 9.1px + 0.32655vw)); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; display: block; }
.projects-gl-caption[data-visible="true"] { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0px); }

.projects-gridzoom__grid { --gallery-gap: clamp(14px, 1.5vw, 26px); will-change: transform; align-items: center; width: max-content; margin: clamp(38px, 7vw, 92px) 0px 0px; padding: 0px 0px clamp(28px, 5vw, 72px); list-style: none; animation: 38s linear 0s infinite normal none running projectsGalleryLoop; display: flex; }
.projects-gridzoom__grid li { height: clamp(280px, 42vw, 560px); padding-right: var(--gallery-gap); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.projects-gridzoom__grid li:nth-child(8n+1) { width: clamp(320px, 34vw, 520px); height: clamp(260px, 36vw, 480px); }
.projects-gridzoom__grid li:nth-child(8n+2) { width: clamp(210px, 22vw, 340px); height: clamp(320px, 44vw, 600px); }
.projects-gridzoom__grid li:nth-child(8n+3) { width: clamp(300px, 30vw, 470px); height: clamp(250px, 34vw, 440px); }
.projects-gridzoom__grid li:nth-child(8n+4) { width: clamp(190px, 20vw, 310px); height: clamp(270px, 38vw, 520px); }
.projects-gridzoom__grid li:nth-child(8n+5) { width: clamp(360px, 40vw, 620px); height: clamp(270px, 36vw, 470px); }
.projects-gridzoom__grid li:nth-child(8n+6) { width: clamp(260px, 26vw, 420px); height: clamp(300px, 42vw, 560px); }
.projects-gridzoom__grid li:nth-child(8n+7) { width: clamp(340px, 36vw, 560px); height: clamp(250px, 34vw, 450px); }

.projects-gridzoom__grid:hover { animation-play-state: paused; }

.projects-gridzoom__item { appearance: none; height: 100%; min-height: inherit; color: rgb(11, 11, 10); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; background: 0px 0px; border: 0px; width: 100%; padding: 0px; transition: clip-path 0.52s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), transform 0.52s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); display: block; position: relative; }

.projects-gridzoom__meta, .projects-gridzoom__name { z-index: 2; color: rgb(11, 11, 10); letter-spacing: 0.045em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; font-size: max(11px, min(0.733vw, 7.15px + 0.25655vw)); line-height: 1; transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.36s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); position: absolute; transform: translateY(8px); }
.projects-gridzoom__meta { color: rgba(11, 11, 10, 0.52); top: -24px; left: 0px; }
